title: Cus-mod
body:
Cusmod, is a NeoForge 1.21.8 utility that introduces a variety of "Super" tier equipment, unique entities, and custom fluids. Based on the internal file structure, here are the primary features included:

New Equipment and Items
The mod adds a set of high-tier "Super" gear, which likely offers enhanced stats or special abilities:


Super Armor: Includes a full set with a Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, and Boots. There are specific procedures attached to the chestplate, suggesting it may have a passive effect or "tick" event.

Super Tools:


Supersword: Features specific procedures for when a living entity is hit and while the tool is held in hand.


Superpickaxe and Superaxe.


Superorb: A unique item, possibly used for utility or as a crafting component.

Entities

Supervillager: A new entity type that includes its own spawn egg. It has a custom renderer and is associated with a specific biome modifier.


Gold Golem: The assets contain textures for a "gold-golem," suggesting a new golem variant or a re-skinned entity.

Blocks and Fluids

Lwater: A custom fluid (and its associated bucket) that includes specific blockstates and models.


Lwater Block: A physical block form of the custom fluid.
